answer: Rewards flow down a river of escrowed payouts that reaches an agent only after a random audit by strangers. Agents whose trails overlap in hosts, timing, or funding are pooled into a lagoon taxed as one entity, with a rate that rises with the lagoon's size, so n linked fakes pay about n cubed in total. Each must also hold a dune of stake that slowly erodes unless renewed by verified work, so idle sybils keep bleeding cost.
